composition.note: 030000 places composition in the early fourteenth century and its historical-context note dates Dante’s life 1265–1321. These conservative outer bounds are not an exact composition interval; the journey’s fictional year 1300 is separate.
composition.label: Early 14th century, by 1321

setting.note: 030000 and the existing chronology source distinguish the poem’s journey set in 1300 from later composition.

description: Examines the journey through the afterlife, the organization of moral judgment, and the poem’s guides, political arguments, and verse. Covers Paradiso: Moon, Mercury, and Venus; Paradiso: Wisdom and Cacciaguida; Paradiso: Justice, Contemplation, and Faith; Justice, Contrapasso, and Sympathy.
